messages:
maria: Heads up — draft announce post + benchmark narrative is ready. Need eng confirmation on changelog links, canary timing, and any required model-variant callouts before we lock the embargo. Can we sync quickly? :eyes:
kevin: Thanks — please paste the changelog snippet and docs links here. Also need canary window and whether we should call out fallback model in the post.
maría (edited): Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launch-drafts/release-embed-story.md
maría: Webinar slot we're eyeing: Tue 04/01 16:00 PT (23:00 UTC). Speaker list and slides in the doc.
tara: I'll publish the docs page to /docs/release-notes once you confirm the final changelog text. ETA EOD today if we lock content now.
josh: Quick product ask — do we want to mention the Dedicated vs Hosted behavior (routing/fallback)? If so, here's a tiny changelog snippet you can paste:```
- routing: automatic fallback to small-quant variant when Dedicated capacity constrained
- rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h; auto-fallback policy applied
```
josh: If you want the exact policy name it's `fallthrough:region-tier-fallback-v2`.
diane: Sales ops — how do leads get routed from the webinar/reg form? We need UTM + SFDC queue mapping. Current preferred queue: Sales > Inbound > MLPlatform.
maria: Planned UTM: ?utm_campaign=release-april&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email. For SFDC queue, can we route to `inbound-ml-evangelists` and tag with product=ReleaseX?
diane: Perfect. Also add `lead_priority=high` for registrants from our paid ads. We'll wire that into Salesforce.
kevin: Canary schedule OK from eng side: start canary Tue 04/01 20:00 UTC at 10% traffic to variant `v1b-quant`, hold 6h, then 50% Wed 04/02 08:00 UTC, full ramp Thu 04/03 02:00 UTC if no regressions. If rollback needed, fallback to `v1a-qt` automatically.
kevin: We will provide stable changelog link after docs publish. For now you can reference draft: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/2026-04-announce.md
maría: Awesome — can everyone react with :thumbsup: when your lane is green? Need final go/no-go by EOD so marketing can set embargo lift Wed morning.
tara: :thumbsup: I'll publish and ping this thread with the final /docs link.
josh: :thumbsup: Product ok. I'll add the fallback blurb to the product notes section.
diane: :thumbsup: Sales ops queued. Need final UTM values before we push the registration form.
deploy-bot: Canary policy applied: name=release-2026-04-canary, variant=v1b-quant, initial_traffic=10%. Monitor: /ops/metrics/release-2026-04
maría: Thanks all — tagging @kevin @tara @diane. Will update the announce doc and post final links here once Tara confirms. :rocket:
